name: block-creds
description: Redacts or blocks credentials (detected by betterleaks) before they are sent to the LLM

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: redact: replace credentials with [REDACTED-...] and send. block: refuse to send.

betterleaksPath.title: betterleaks command
betterleaksPath.description: Name or absolute path of the betterleaks binary

configPath.title: betterleaks config file (optional)
configPath.description: Absolute path of a betterleaks.toml passed with -c. Leave empty for betterleaks' default rules. A project's .betterleaks.toml / .gitleaks.toml, ignore files and BETTERLEAKS_* / GITLEAKS_* variables are never used.

hashKey.title: Key for the placeholder hash (optional)
hashKey.description: Key for the [REDACTED-...] hash, so the same secret gets the same placeholder across sessions and restarts. Empty: a random key is generated on first run and kept in the plugin's own store.

restoreInToolInput.title: Restore placeholders in tool input
restoreInToolInput.description: Swap [REDACTED-...] back to the real value in the arguments of local tools (Bash, PowerShell, Write, Edit, NotebookEdit, Read, Grep, Glob), so commands that use a redacted secret still work. Other tools (MCP, WebFetch, subagents...) always get the placeholder. In auto mode a call that needs the classifier's approval is refused instead.

restoreInDisplay.title: Restore placeholders on screen
restoreInDisplay.description: Draw the real value in place of [REDACTED-...] in what you see (replies, tool rows). Only the drawing changes; what the model reads keeps the placeholder.
